description: The bar chart compares the distribution of three categories—Context, Generated Response, and Other—between two methods: "Ours" and "Standard." The horizontal axis represents the methods, while the vertical axis indicates the percentage of each category. For the "Ours" method, the Context category accounts for 60.6%, the Generated Response for 31.7%, and Other for 7.7%. In contrast, the "Standard" method shows a smaller Context category at 23.6%, a larger Generated Response at 51.1%, and Other at 25.3%. The bars are color-coded with blue for Context, orange for Generated Response, and green for Other. The chart does not include any additional visual emphasis or sorting, and the values are presented as percentages without a specific scale type indicated.
